title: Phosphor trace
description: A synthetic waveform sweeps across phosphor green gridwork with a restrained afterglow.
useCase: Audio tools, signal-processing products, experimental music releases, or a technical brand texture.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. This is a synthetic decorative signal, not an audio visualizer or live measurement.
look: Near-black green CRT screen with a faint ruled grid, a glowing lime waveform with soft ghost trails, scanline texture, vignette and small monospace labels.
motion: A two-sine waveform drifts continuously across the grid with a faint 0.2 s afterimage, while a brightness sweep scans left to right about every 6.7 s.
adapt: The waveform is `trace` in `FRAGMENT` (two sines; edit amplitudes and frequencies), with `ghost` for the afterglow, `sweep` for the scan and `grid` for the graticule; recolour via `vec3(.52,1.0,.24)`. Replace the monospace label spans with your own copy.
